### Added

- 168時間トッピングの終端で回線カバレッジが途切れる時間を最小化するため、実終了時刻の検出、正確なアラーム、foreground service、成功までの再試行を追加した。
- 途中利用から開始できるように、メール本文から同一プリペイドコードと入力期限を抽出し、サーバー側の残り利用可否を正として繰り返す処理を追加した。
- 認証情報を複製せずログイン済みセッションを利用し、失効時にコードを保留して再ログイン後に復旧する処理を追加した。
- プリペイドコードを端末内で保護するため、Android Keystore と AES-GCM による暗号化保存を追加した。
- Android 16 の AQUOS R8 pro を対象に、再起動復旧、正確なアラーム権限、バックグラウンド実行用コンポーネントを追加した。
- ReVanced Manager が取得できる `patches.json` と Patcher 22 対応 RVP のリリース基盤を追加した。
- 公式 povo 2.0 のアプリデータとログイン状態を保持したまま実機検証できるように、パッケージID、provider authority、アプリ固有 permission/action を衝突しない別IDへ変更する検証専用パッチを追加した。
- 設定場所が分からない状態を解消するため、ホーム画面へ状態付きの黄色い自動更新カードを常設し、メール登録・終了日時設定・一時停止へ直接移動できる導線を追加した。
- 契約APIが「残り○時間」だけを返す場合でも途中利用から開始できるように、初回の現在終了日時を設定する入力欄を追加した。
- 24回目の後に不要な再試行を行わないように、最大回数と現在利用中の回数を設定し、成功ごとに進捗を増やして最大到達時に停止する処理を追加した。
- 24時間・3日・7日など時間型のプリペイドトッピングへ対応できるように、メール本文から1回の有効時間を抽出し、必要なら時間単位で修正できる設定を追加した。
- 商品構成の変更に追従できるように、メール本文から商品種別、コードに紐づく回数、即時適用回数、有効時間、入力期限を抽出する汎用商品モデルと、旧設定の明示的な状態移行を追加した。

### Changed

- 初回設定で多数のボタンに迷わないように、メール・回数・終了日時を1つの主ボタンで保存し、設定済みの場合だけ一時停止と削除を表示する段階的な画面へ変更した。
- 単発コードの誤反復とまとめ商品の回数ずれを防ぐため、終端ごとの自動再適用を `repeatable_time_code` だけに限定し、購入直後の即時適用分とメールで届くコード回数を分離して数えるように変更した。
- GitHub ActionsのNode.js 20廃止警告を解消するため、checkout、Javaセットアップ、Gradleセットアップ、artifact upload、build provenanceを各公式の現行メジャーへ更新した。

### Fixed

- 7日24回分を前提にした欠損時の `24` 回・`168` 時間が別商品へ混入しないようにし、既存の7日24回分設定だけを同じ値のまま移行するよう修正した。
- メール末尾の販売予定日を入力期限と誤認しないように、「入力期限」ラベルに続く日時を優先して抽出するよう修正した。
- 登録中の反復コードとは別の単発コードを手入力した結果で利用回数が増えないように、自動送信または登録直後の送信と、その応答を1回ずつ対応付けるよう修正した。

### Security

- 長い入力による制御不能な再帰を防ぐため、ReVancedの推移依存で解決されていた脆弱な Apache Commons Lang 3.17.0 を、修正済みの3.20.0へ明示的に更新した（`GHSA-j288-q9x7-2f5v`）。

HushTelegram v0.0.6 has 18 patches for telegram.org's Telegram 12.10.6 (`org.telegram.messenger.web`), up from 4 in v0.0.4. Every patch is selected by default, and each feature has its own switch in HushTelegram settings.

## What's new

- **Hide Stories** hides the story bar above your chats, the story rings on avatars and the Post Story button, and Telegram stops fetching the story list. Stories on a profile and your archive are still there when you open them.
- **Hide recommendations** hides similar channels and bots.
- **Hide Premium, gifts and Stars** takes Premium, Stars, Business and Send a Gift out of Settings, and hides profile Gifts tabs and the channel Gift button.
- **Hide promotional banners** hides the Premium, birthday and low Stars balance banners in the chat list. Account security notices still show.
- **Hide sponsored proxy channel** hides the channel a proxy sponsors from your chat list and folders.
- **Hide popular apps** hides the Popular apps list in search's Apps tab.
- **Quiet contacts nag** stops the Contacts tab asking for contacts access again once you've said no.
- **Disable call debug upload** stops the call debug reports and log uploads Telegram's server asks for.
- **Disable analytics** now also keeps the Premium screen reports on your phone.
- **Open links externally** opens ordinary web links in your browser. Telegram links and logins open the way they always have.
- Five new switches start off, so nothing changes until you turn them on. **Strip link tracking** takes utm tags, gclid and fbclid off links you open or share. **Disable draft link previews** stops Telegram fetching previews for messages you haven't sent yet. **Gallery camera on tap** keeps the attachment gallery from starting the camera until you tap the camera tile. **Disable chat swipe actions** keeps a sideways swipe from archiving, muting, pinning or deleting a chat. **Holiday look all year** keeps Telegram's New Year snow falling over the chat list and chat backgrounds.

## Install

1. Install [Morphe Manager](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager) 1.32.0 or newer.
2. Add HushTelegram as a patch source: https://morphe.software/add-source?github=SysAdminDoc%2FHushTelegram
3. Download Telegram **12.10.6** from [telegram.org](https://telegram.org/android), version code **71129**, and patch it. The patched app needs Android 9 or newer.
4. Coming from v0.0.4? Patch again and install over it with the same Morphe Manager signing key. New to HushTelegram? Uninstall the stock Telegram first, since Android won't put one over the other. Your chats come back when you sign in, but secret chats don't. Back up Morphe Manager's signing key after your first patch, you'll need it for every update.
5. For notifications, open Telegram's Settings, then Notifications and Sounds, and turn on Keep-Alive Service and Background Connection. Google's push service only delivers to Telegram's own signed build, so a patched Telegram relies on its own connection.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a Telegram APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushTelegram#install).

## Validation

512 runtime tests and 232 patch tests passed locally, along with both Android lints and the release script checks. All 18 patches applied without forcing to Telegram 12.10.6. The dependency advisory check passed. On a signed-in Android 16 phone the patched app ran with every patch, and the New Year snow came and went with its switch.

Hushfeed v0.29.0 targets global TikTok 46.2.3 (com.zhiliaoapp.musically).

New here: a switch that empties the menu TikTok puts under its own icon on your home screen. Press and hold the icon and you normally get a short list of shortcuts into the app. TikTok builds that list while it runs rather than declaring it anywhere, and it only rewrites the list when it notices a difference, so the switch takes away what is already published as well as answering the handover that would publish more. Turn it off and TikTok is asked to build the list again. Tapping the icon still opens the app, and a shortcut you pinned to a home screen yourself stays where you put it.

The rest of this went into checking things rather than changing them, and one check turned up something worth saying out loud. The v0.28.0 download was built a couple of commits before the release it went out as, so the build stamp inside it named the wrong commit and nobody could rebuild that file and arrive at the published checksum. The patches inside were the right ones, entry for entry. It was replaced on 2026-09-10 and that release says so.

Validation: 1009 runtime tests passed locally, plus fifty-one in the patches module. The bundle carries 71 patches and applied cleanly to the vendor APK. Every instruction the patches inject was held to the register count of the method it landed in, and the result went through the Android runtime's own verifier on a phone, where it raised nothing the unpatched app does not raise by itself. Needs Morphe Manager 1.29.0 or newer.

The downloadable .mpp is the patch bundle. Patch on the device with Morphe Manager and keep its existing signing key.

## What changed

GIF conversion now checks its colour precision and palette work separately. Frame encoding has its own deadline coverage too. Logger also contains failures from message builders whose own error text is broken.

Comment tools resolves every native anchor and register before changing an APK. Other patch checks now catch Java binary class names, inherited reflection contracts, false Lazy AB dispatch matches, incompatible CAPTCHA methods, and incomplete patch reports earlier.

Settings journal recovery has direct coverage for failed writes and unreadable records. Cleanup failures now keep the recovered result. Video fitting requests layout after changing gravity, while its feed and story ownership tests cover results that cannot be copied.

Release and device scripts now honor explicit Java directories, handle a clean phone during replacement, derive target metadata from the catalog, protect signing passwords from child process command lines, and verify a published bundle against its source tag.

## Validation

The release passed 1,054 runtime tests and 139 patch tests. Both Android API checks passed. The bundle carries 71 patches and all three DEX payloads are non-empty.

All 71 patches applied with zero failures to TikTok 46.2.3, 46.7.3, and 46.8.3 fixtures. Hushfeed officially targets the global TikTok 46.2.3 package. Morphe Manager 1.29.0 or newer is required.

Two more Messenger builds work now, and there's a way to hide the extra settings icon. Still 27 patches.

**New**

- **Hide app drawer icon**, in the App tab. It removes the separate "HushMessenger settings" icon from your app list. Settings still open from the long-press **Patch controls** shortcut and the HushMessenger row in the Menu tab. The switch only shows up when that Menu row applied, so you can't lock yourself out.
- Build **346013370** is supported. That's the APK Morphe Manager's download link handed out, and it used to stop with "version code 346013370 is not supported". It hasn't been tried on a phone yet, since both test phones run newer builds.
- Build **346013354**, APKMirror's arm64 nodpi bundle of 580.0.0.49.91, is supported too.

**Changed and fixed**

- **Allow screenshots** now covers Android 14 and newer, where Messenger hears about screenshots from Android itself, and the photo and media viewers that lock their window in a protected chat. View-once media stays protected.
- A Facebook patched with the same key as Messenger, like Hushfacebook, is no longer turned away when it asks Messenger for its shared message keys. Meta's own rules still decide what it gets. Any other app, or a Facebook signed with a different key, gets the old answer.
- The line under each switch only shows while the switch is on. It no longer says "Not active since restart", which made working switches look broken.
- The App tab's Quick access card mentions the Menu tab row on builds that have it.
- The README explains how to get alerts from only the chats you pick, with Messenger's own settings.

**Updating**

Refresh the HushMessenger source in Morphe, patch Messenger again with the same key and install it over your current copy. Then use Restart Messenger.

All five supported builds (346013387, 346013440, 346013442, 346013354 and 346013370) take all 27 patches, and clean builds from two separate checkouts give the same bundle.

The full list is in the [changelog](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushMessenger/blob/v0.6.0/CHANGELOG.md).

Hushfeed v0.67.0 has 106 patches for global TikTok 47.0.3, 47.1.3 and 47.1.4 (`com.zhiliaoapp.musically`). It needs Morphe Manager 1.33.0 or newer.

## What's changed

* TikTok's "Videos you might like" pushes, the ones like "25M+ people viewed", are blocked by the new Block suggested video notifications patch. It's on from the first launch, and its switch under Inbox lets them through again. Messages, comments, likes, follows and videos from accounts you follow aren't touched.
* Stop saving search history is new too. With Privacy > Don't save new searches on, new searches stay out of the history TikTok keeps on your phone.
* Feed text sizes gives the video description and the creator's name their own sizes on the Feed screen page (#66).
* The LIVE feed you open with the LIVE button can be filtered now (#57).
* Hide profile shortcuts takes the shortcuts you pick off the row under a profile's bio, like TikTok Studio or Your orders (#49).
* Stop TikTok's benchmark runs, on the Privacy page, keeps TikTok's phone benchmark from starting in the background (#64).
* Streaks take several usernames, separated by commas or new lines (#73), and Hushfeed's settings come in Azerbaijani (#77).
* Hide search rewards keeps the floating coin off search along with the points banner (#21). Restart TikTok after you change it.
* Hide the status bar, and a new Hide the comment bar on opened videos switch, work on videos you open from a profile, a hashtag, a sound or search (#50).
* A double tap, long press or swipe set to open comments goes to the video on screen, not the one you just left. The other long press actions do too (#63).
* Show author region puts the country on the video you're watching after a swipe down (#75).
* Hide the music line also hides the "Contains:" song credit (#68). Share actions you've excluded by name stay hidden after the sheet reopens (#74).
* With Download original photos on, Download video on a photo post saves the original images instead of TikTok's watermarked video (#71).
* Hushfeed works in a copy of TikTok made with Morphe's Clone app patch (#59), and the resource optimizers accept an APK split down to one ABI (#43).
* Remove unused language packs keeps every language unless you list the ones you want (#67). If you patched with an older bundle, check what that option says.
* Hide CAPTCHA popups isn't available for now, so every verification challenge stays visible.
* About > Build details copies or saves what your build was patched with, and automatic reports include it.
* Hushfeed is built with Morphe patcher 1.15.0 now, which is why it needs Manager 1.33.0. In a test with memory held near what Manager gets on a phone, the new patcher finished saving patched TikTok 47.1.4 where the old one ran out of memory.

See the [changelog](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushFeed/blob/v0.67.0/CHANGELOG.md) for the full list.

## Checked

* 2733 runtime tests and 533 patch tests passed. Both Android lint checks passed.
* All 106 patches applied to all three supported APKs. Resource checks passed, and the manifest changes are the reviewed ones from earlier releases. The attached release receipt records the exact bundle and each target's result.
* On a Samsung phone running TikTok 47.0.3, the music line, the share sheet exclusions and photo post saves were checked by hand.

## Install

Use Morphe Manager 1.33.0 or newer. An older Manager says the bundle needs a Manager update. Refresh the Hushfeed source, select the TikTok 47.0.3, 47.1.3 or 47.1.4 APK, then patch and install it. Keep the manager's existing signing key when updating.

`patches-0.67.0.mpp` is the patch bundle, not a TikTok APK. `SHA256SUMS.txt` includes checksums for the bundle and its release receipt.

The first release, with 17 patches for Pinterest 14.38.0. Pinterest 14.25.0 patches the same way for phones on Android 9. Hide ads, Disable analytics and Strip link tracking are selected by default along with the settings, and everything else starts off until you pick it.

## What's new

- Hide ads removes promoted pins from the home feed, search, related pins and boards before Pinterest draws them, so they don't leave a gap. The four panels Pinterest only builds for an ad stay folded away too.
- Hide AI-labeled pins is an optional Feed switch. It takes out the pins Pinterest itself labels as made or changed with AI, using the same label Pinterest shows on the pin.
- Hide shopping and product pins is an optional Feed switch for shoppable pins, shopping stories and featured board placements. It reads both of the ways Pinterest marks them.
- Disable analytics stops Pinterest's usage-event and performance uploads and AppsFlyer tracking while sign-in, the feed and pins keep loading. Its switch and Pause bring those uploads back, and Firebase Analytics is turned off when you patch.
- Strip link tracking takes known tracking parameters off links you copy or share. The destination, signed parameters and pin.it short links stay as they are.
- Download pins adds Download pin to the pin menu for original images and the highest-resolution MP4 Pinterest supplies. Android 10 and newer save in Downloads, and Android 9 asks where to save.
- Download history shows each download's current status, even after Pinterest restarts, with Retry or a way back to the pin. Removing an entry keeps the file.
- On Android 9, Pending saves explains what to check if a save was interrupted. Saves there have a five-minute and 256 MiB limit, and a file that might have finished is kept.
- Pin actions show a pin's media size and type when Pinterest supplies them, and explain why a pin has nothing to download.
- Open links in your browser sends a pin's Visit link to your browser, and System share sheet uses Android's share sheet, including from the Share button at the top of a pin. Both start off.
- Interface has new optional switches for the screenshot share menu, recent searches, comments, the Create and Updates buttons, header icon buttons and the collage, visual search and Promote pin menu entries. They all start off.
- Quiet email reminders and Disable update nag give the confirm-your-email reminder and the in-app Play Store update prompt their own switches. The update prompt switch is for 14.38.0.
- HushPinterest settings opens from a long-press on Pinterest's icon or from Pinterest's App info page, with a switch for every patch, Pause, diagnostics and a settings backup. It's in German, Spanish, Indonesian, Brazilian Portuguese and Turkish as well as English.
- Settings search finds controls by their common names in every supported language, and each Interface summary says what it changes and when.
- Import settings shows each switch's old and new value before applying a file, and Undo puts your previous switches back once. If an import can't finish, your switches stay as they were. Exports and imports keep all 19 feature choices.
- About has an optional setup guide covering patch choices, settings backup and your signing key, with links to Pinterest's password and data-export help. It walks you through setting a Pinterest password if you joined through Google.
- The Supported links button opens Android's link settings, so pinterest.com and pin.it links can open in the patched app.
- If a settings page can't load, Retry tries again and Back returns to Pinterest.
- Diagnostic reports say where they were saved, and Copy quick report is there when storage isn't. Links, IDs and sign-in secrets are taken out.
- Updates checks every Pinterest version a release supports, including the Android 9 build, and links to the release notes and install steps. It never downloads anything by itself.
- Pinterest 14.38.0 is the target, and 14.25.0 stays supported for Android 9. Every patch was checked against both builds.

## Tooling

- The bundle is built with Morphe patcher 1.15.0, so it needs Morphe Manager 1.33.0 or newer.
- The project starts from HushTelegram's build, shared extension library and release checks. Every file carried over names HushTelegram in its header and in provenance.json.
- Release checksums are signed with the HushPinterest release key, FCE5ECE3182A647B3AF2C5ED2DC35E8D5C00E8A6, and scripts/verify-release-checksums.ps1 checks a download offline.
- Before a patched APK is delivered, the checks hold its manifest to the selected patches and require every feature hook, fallback path and inserted call to resolve.
- Device helpers take an exclusive device lease, verify the device and both signing keys, and update in place without removing apps or clearing data. Concurrent builds keep separate outputs.
- Commons Lang, HttpClient and Guava resolve to reviewed versions, checksums are strict and the advisory gate refuses vulnerable resolutions.
- Gradle runs at low priority with two workers and a bounded heap so the desktop stays responsive.
- The source ledger records every other Pinterest patch project reviewed, at pinned commits. None of their Pinterest code was adopted.
- A crimson Hush emblem with a push pin and a matching dark README hero bring Pinterest into the Hush family.

## Install

1. Install [Morphe Manager](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager) 1.33.0 or newer.
2. Add HushPinterest as a patch source: https://morphe.software/add-source?github=SysAdminDoc%2FHushPinterest
3. Download Pinterest **14.38.0**, version code **14388010**, as the universal APK, and patch it. On Android 9, use Pinterest **14.25.0**, version code **14258020**.
4. Uninstall the stock Pinterest first, since Android won't put one over the other. Save anything you keep only on the phone before you do. Your boards and pins come back when you sign in.
5. Sign in with your email and a Pinterest password. If you joined through Google or Facebook, tap **Forgot your password?** on Pinterest's login page to set one first.
6. Right after your first patch, export Morphe Manager's signing key (Settings, then System, then Import & export, then Signing key) and keep it somewhere private. Updates only install over a Pinterest signed with that same key.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a Pinterest APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushPinterest#install). `SHA256SUMS.txt` is signed with the HushPinterest release key, fingerprint `FCE5 ECE3 182A 647B 3AF2  C5ED 2DC3 5E8D 5C00 E8A6`. [How to check a download](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushPinterest#verify-a-release-download).

## Validation

All 146 patch tests and 640 extension tests passed on this commit, none skipped. The bundle attached here was patched onto real Pinterest 14.38.0 and 14.25.0 APKs with Morphe's desktop patcher, and all 17 patches applied to both without forcing. `release-receipt-0.0.3.json` records each of those results, the APK hashes and what patching changed in the app's manifest.

On a signed-in Android 16 phone running patched 14.38.0, promoted pins were gone from the home feed, search, related pins and board grids, and the feed kept scrolling normally. With Disable analytics on, Pinterest's tracking host and AppsFlyer stopped showing up in the phone's traffic while sign-in, the feed and pins kept loading. Pin downloads, sharing, browser links, settings import with Undo, Supported links and the setup guide were all tried on that phone as well. An update signed with the same key installed over the existing patched app.

## BannerHub v6 1.0.0-607 > ## ⚠️ Important — please read before installing > > **BannerHub v6 does NOT replace BannerHub 3.7.x or BannerHub Lite — they are SEPARATE projects.** > > - **BannerHub** 3.7.x — built from the GameHub 5.3.5 ReVanced project by **PlayDay**. > - **BannerHub Lite** — built from GameHub Lite 5.1.4 by **Producdevity**. > - **BannerHub v6** *(this repo)* — built from XiaoJi GameHub 6.0.x on a brand-new pipeline. > > **None of the three are to be updated over by any of the others.** Each ships with its own package names, its own keystore, and its own component / Steam-client backend — Android won't accept an in-place update between them, and forcing one will leave you with a broken install. Uninstall first, then install the new project if you want to switch. > > Keep in mind **BannerHub v6 is still a work in progress** and will re-release frequently as new base GameHub versions come out from XiaoJi upstream. **Compatibility is different** — don't expect every game that works on BannerHub 3.7.x or Lite to work on v6, and vice versa. v6 uses a **new component system and new Steam clients** and, thus far, has been **barely tested in general**. > > **USE AT YOUR OWN RISK.** A patched build of **XiaoJi GameHub 6.0.7** that removes the login requirement (import and play games with no account) and redirects the catalog to the BannerHub Cloudflare Worker. Ships **9 variants that install side-by-side**. **9 APKs attached.** Steam game launches work end-to-end. > **No separate Lite builds on the 6.0.7 base.** XiaoJi's own −46% size pass plus the privacy/size strips folded into every variant make the full 6.0.7 build (~46 MB) smaller than the old 6.0.4 Lite — so a distinct Lite would strip nothing extra. The Lite concept is absorbed. 🔒 **Privacy-hardened** — upstream telemetry/analytics channels stripped at the bytecode level. Full list of killed channels (and the honest leftovers) in [`PRIVACY.md`](https://github.com/The412Banner/bannerhub-revanced/blob/gamehub-607-build/PRIVACY.md).
✨ Everything BannerHub v6 offers (click to expand) - **No login required** — launch straight to the home screen and import/play games without a XiaoJi account. - **Custom catalog API** — the catalog is redirected to the BannerHub Cloudflare Worker for **curated component delivery** (hand-picked DXVK, VKD3D-Proton, Box64, FEX, Mesa Turnip driver builds, etc.) instead of the stock upstream set. - **Privacy-hardened** — upstream telemetry/analytics channels stripped at the bytecode level (see the `PRIVACY.md` link above for the full list). - **PC-accurate controller vibration** — real XInput rumble routed into Android's VibratorManager with independent dual-motor support, configurable **per-game** (mode + intensity) via the **PC Vibration Settings** menu row. Preload-free — no `libevshim` / `LD_PRELOAD`. - **GOG integration** — sign in to GOG, browse your owned library, and download + install GOG games in-app; they're added to your GameHub library and launch like any other PC game. Reached from the Explore tab's GOG card or the Banner Tools → GOG tile. - **BannerHub Explore homepage** — the bottom-nav "Explore" tab opens a BannerHub-owned homepage instead of the stock online discovery feed: wordmark/logo hero, a "What's New" article that auto-syncs from the release notes, the GOG store card, and an in-app **update banner + installed-vs-latest version readout** with a settings cog. Content can refresh live via an external JSON override; still fully offline-capable. - **Recording-compatible audio** — optional toggle (Banner Tools → Audio) that routes PulseAudio through the mixer so screen recorders capture in-game sound. - **In-game performance overlay** *(root)* — a draggable edge pill → slide-out panel for live CPU-governor + Adreno min-clock toggles while gaming; off by default, root-gated, auto-reverts on exit. Toggle from Banner Tools → In-game Overlay. - **9 side-by-side variants** — different package names + launcher labels so multiple builds coexist on one device (`Original` replaces stock GameHub; the rest install alongside it). - **Root-free file manager access** — a content provider lets MT Manager and similar apps browse GameHub's data dir without root. - **Portrait PC-settings** — per-game PC settings render in both landscape and portrait (side benefit of the API redirect). - **Installs in place** — stable signing keystore; future BannerHub v6 stables upgrade without uninstalling. - **BannerHub v6 branding** — custom app icon, Wine container header, and auth/splash artwork. - **Triage-friendly** — debuggable build with logcat markers along the import path.
## What's new in 1.0.0-607 First BannerHub v6 build on the **GameHub 6.0.7** base (versionCode 118). Same keystore as the 6.0.4 line, so it installs in place over the `-604` series. ### 🧱 Rebased onto GameHub 6.0.7 Every BannerHub v6 patch was re-fingerprinted against the 6.0.7 bytecode (R8 reshuffle, the `:wine` process folded into the main process, `com.winemu.openapi.Config` removed, the Compose menu rewrite) and **device-verified** end-to-end. ### 🪶 Smaller — and no separate Lite The full 6.0.7 build is ~47 MB — already smaller than the old 6.0.4 **Lite**. XiaoJi's own −46 % size pass, plus the privacy/size strips folded into every variant, mean a distinct Lite would strip nothing extra, so the Lite concept is absorbed. ### ⚠️ GPU Spoof and the Legacy renderer toggle were removed Two per-game tiles from the 6.0.4 line are **gone on 6.0.7**: - **GPU Spoof** — 6.0.7 ships its own **native GPU spoof**, so the BannerHub patch is redundant. - **Legacy renderer (GLES2) toggle** — 6.0.7's rewritten Vulkan X-server is **incompatible** with the old GLES2 `libxserver.so` / `libwinemu.so` pair (device-confirmed `SIGABRT`), so the renderer patches stay pinned to 6.0.4. The Banner Tools grid on 6.0.7 is now **Vibration · Game ID · Audio · GOG · Overlay · Root**. ### ✅ Everything else carries over GOG integration, the BannerHub Explore homepage (update banner + installed-vs-latest readout), PC-accurate controller vibration, the in-game performance overlay (root), recording-compatible audio, the offline component picker, and the full privacy-hardening stack all ship forward unchanged. ### Variants Each variant has its own package name + launcher label, so the variants install **side-by-side** with each other. `Original` replaces an installed GameHub; the rest install alongside it. | Variant | Package | APK | | --- | --- | --- | | Normal | `banner.hub` | `…-Normal.apk` | | Normal-GHL | `gamehub.lite` | `…-Normal-GHL.apk` | | PuBG | `com.tencent.ig` | `…-PuBG.apk` | | AnTuTu | `com.antutu.ABenchMark` | `…-AnTuTu.apk` | | alt-AnTuTu | `com.antutu.benchmark.full` | `…-alt-AnTuTu.apk` | | PuBG-CrossFire | `com.tencent.tmgp.cf` | `…-PuBG-CrossFire.apk` | | Ludashi | `com.ludashi.aibench` | `…-Ludashi.apk` | | Genshin | `com.miHoYo.GenshinImpact` | `…-Genshin.apk` | | Original | `com.xiaoji.egggame` | `…-Original.apk` | Filenames follow `BannerHub-V6-1.0.0-607-Patched-{variant}.apk`. ## Gamehub 6.0.1 - BannerHub API - Patched

A patched build of XiaoJi GameHub 6.0.1 (`com.xiaoji.egggame`, versionCode 111) that removes the login requirement so games can be imported and used without an account, redirects the catalog API to the BannerHub Cloudflare Worker, and ships **9 variants that install side-by-side on the same device**.

### 🛠️ Hotfix vs v1.0.0-601

**v1.0.0-601 shipped with three patches silently broken** because R8 in the 6.0.1 base APK reshuffled class letters between 6.0.0 and 6.0.1, and the patcher's class-letter-keyed fingerprints matched unrelated classes instead of the intended auth/API targets — the patcher reported success but the methods were never actually rewritten. This hotfix re-anchors all three patches against the new 6.0.1 letters and adds structural-anchor comments in the patch sources so future minor-version bumps are easy to track down.

- **Bypass login** — was no-op on v1.0.0-601 (login wall on library tap). Now patches `Lrs0;` (was `Los0;`), `Lls0;` (was `Lis0;`), `Lhp7;` (was `Lxm7;`), `Lade;` (was `Lg8e;`), and the new 6.0.1-only `Lar0;` NavigationInterceptor. Login is bypassed end-to-end; library opens straight to home.
- **Redirect catalog API** — was no-op on v1.0.0-601 (catalog requests went to upstream `landscape-api.vgabc.com` instead of the BannerHub Worker). Now patches `Lzhj;` (was `Lmcj;`); both Online enum hosts redirect to `bannerhub-api.the412banner.workers.dev`.
- **Prefix API path with /v6** — was no-op on v1.0.0-601 (the Worker received unprefixed requests and served the 5.x response shapes, not the 6.0-specific reshapes). Now patches `Lohb;->b(Lj1a;String)V` (was `Lzdb;->b(Lqx9;String)V`); every relative path from the patched 6.0.1 client carries the `v6/` tag.

### ✅ Same as v1.0.0-601 (base APK refresh from 6.0.0 → 6.0.1)

Same 9 patches on top of the GameHub 6.0.1 base (versionCode 111). Same multi-install fix from v1.0.1-600: side-by-side variants install cleanly on the same device with all three install-blockers from v1.0.0-600 (MT provider authority collision, signature-protected DYNAMIC_RECEIVER_NOT_EXPORTED_PERMISSION, Mob Push SDK C2D_MESSAGE permission) addressed.

**Migrating from v1.0.0-601 or earlier:** uninstall any previously-installed BannerHub-ReVanced variant of the same name first — release-to-release the signing keystore changes (CI generates a fresh debug keystore each run), so Android refuses cross-release upgrades with `INSTALL_FAILED_UPDATE_INCOMPATIBLE`. Within v1.0.1-601 itself, all 9 variants share signing and install side-by-side.

### 🆕 New in GameHub 6.0.1 (upstream)

These are XiaoJi-side improvements that came with the 6.0.1 base APK; you get them automatically by using this build:

1. **Improved Steam login and game download stability**
2. **Faster Steam game launch speeds**
3. **Virtual button layouts can now be switched dynamically via keypress**
4. **Multiple new touchscreen input methods**
5. **Gyroscope support for camera control**
6. **AI frame generation now supported across all games**
7. **Numerous bug fixes**

### Source
- **Base APK**: `GameHub_6.0.1.apk` — the official 6.0.1 global build (versionCode 111), attached to [`base-apk-601`](https://github.com/The412Banner/bannerhub-revanced/releases/tag/base-apk-601)
- **Patcher**: ReVanced CLI 6.0.0 + this repo's patch bundle, branch `gamehub-601-build`
- **Repo**: https://github.com/The412Banner/bannerhub-revanced

### Variants

Nine APKs are produced from the same patch bundle, each with a different package name + launcher label so they install side-by-side. The `Original` variant **replaces** an installed GameHub; the rest install **alongside** the original.

| Variant | APK | Package | Launcher label |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Normal | `GameHub-6.0.1-Patched-Normal.apk` | `banner.hub` | GameHub |
| Normal (GHL) | `GameHub-6.0.1-Patched-Normal(GHL).apk` | `gamehub.lite` | GameHub |
| PuBG | `GameHub-6.0.1-Patched-PuBG.apk` | `com.tencent.ig` | GameHub PuBG |
| AnTuTu | `GameHub-6.0.1-Patched-AnTuTu.apk` | `com.antutu.ABenchMark` | GameHub AnTuTu |
| alt-AnTuTu | `GameHub-6.0.1-Patched-alt-AnTuTu.apk` | `com.antutu.benchmark.full` | GameHub AnTuTu |
| PuBG-CrossFire | `GameHub-6.0.1-Patched-PuBG-CrossFire.apk` | `com.tencent.tmgp.cf` | GameHub PuBG CrossFire |
| Ludashi | `GameHub-6.0.1-Patched-Ludashi.apk` | `com.ludashi.aibench` | GameHub Ludashi |
| Genshin | `GameHub-6.0.1-Patched-Genshin.apk` | `com.miHoYo.GenshinImpact` | GameHub Genshin |
| Original | `GameHub-6.0.1-Patched-Original.apk` | `com.xiaoji.egggame` | GameHub |

### Patches applied

| Patch | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| **Bypass login** | Skips the login screen entirely. Replaces `rs0.h()`'s isLoggedIn StateFlow to emit `TRUE`, replaces `rs0.e()`'s user-account StateFlow to emit a synthetic `adm{user_id="99999"}` so library queries return rows, replaces `hp7.f()` and `ls0.f()` to keep the user-id consistent across read/write paths, and short-circuits the `ade.i/r` Login navigator gates plus the new `ar0.a` NavigationInterceptor that 6.0.1 added. Result: launches straight into the home screen; game-import saves persist to `db_game_library.db`; imported games appear in the library list. |
| **Disable Firebase Crashlytics** | Removes the Crashlytics initialisation block in reverse instruction order so the ART verifier accepts the resulting bytecode. Without this, GameHub 6.0.1 crashes on launch with `VerifyError`. |
| **Debug logging** | Sets `android:debuggable="true"` and inserts `Log.i("GH600-DEBUG", ...)` markers along the import code path (Save → Room DAO inserts) plus a `Throwable` hook on the global exception swallower. Used to triage the import flow during development; will be removed in a follow-up build once the import flow is confirmed stable. |
| **File manager access** | Adds an exposed `MTDataFiles` content provider so external file managers can browse GameHub's data directory. The provider authority and wake-up activity `taskAffinity` are derived per-variant from `packageNameOption.value` so two variants don't collide on `INSTALL_FAILED_CONFLICTING_PROVIDER`. |
| **Rewrite custom permissions per variant** | Iterates the manifest's `<permission>` and `<uses-permission>` elements; any whose name starts `com.xiaoji.egggame.permission.` (notably the Mob Push SDK's `C2D_MESSAGE`) gets the prefix rewritten to the variant package. Without this, Android 7+ rejects the second-installed variant with `INSTALL_FAILED_DUPLICATE_PERMISSION`. |
| **Mute UI sounds** | Replaces the bundled UI feedback sounds (`assets/.../sound/*.wav`) with silent PCM, so menu navigation and button taps no longer click. The patch substitutes the resource at packaging time — no runtime audio routing is changed. |
| **Redirect catalog API** | Patches the `zhj` environment enum's `Online` value so the catalog API's `cnHost` and `overseaHost` both point at the BannerHub Cloudflare Worker (`bannerhub-api.the412banner.workers.dev`) instead of `landscape-api-{cn,oversea}.vgabc.com`. The Worker serves a curated component catalog from GitHub Pages and forwards unallowlisted paths back to the original upstream with the original signed-request behavior preserved. Beta + Test enum values, the analytics hosts, and the bigeyes CDN are intentionally untouched. **Side benefit:** the per-game **PC game settings** screen now renders correctly in both landscape *and* portrait orientation. Upstream's response constrained the screen to landscape only; the BannerHub Worker's payload doesn't carry that constraint, so the picker is usable from a portrait-held phone for the first time. |
| **Prefix API path with /v6** | Hooks `ohb.b(j1a, String)` — the single Ktor URL-builder chokepoint every relative API call funnels through — and prepends `v6/` to the path. Together with **Redirect catalog API**, this lets the Worker serve 6.0-only response variants (firmware 1.3.5 vs 1.3.3, `base.fileType=0`, the `EnvListData` wrapper required by 6.0's kotlinx-strict deserializer) without affecting 5.x clients, which never carry the prefix. Full URLs (`http://`, `https://`) are passed through untouched so direct downloads still work. |
| **Change package name** *(per variant)* | Rewrites the APK's package name to the variant's value listed above. The `Original` variant keeps `com.xiaoji.egggame`. |
| **Change app name** *(per variant)* | Rewrites the launcher label to the variant's value listed above. |

### ⚠ Known limitations — please read

- **Steam game launches via the standard Steam client are likely broken.** Redirecting the catalog API to the BannerHub Worker changes which Steam client component the host resolves at launch. If your Steam games stop launching after upgrading, switch to the **Lightweight Steam client** in the picker — it's the variant that pairs cleanly with the BannerHub catalog. The standard Steam client may still work for some titles, but Lightweight should be your default on this build.
- **Imported games have no cover art by default.** When you add a game via Import, no banner / cover / hero artwork is fetched automatically. Open the imported game's edit screen and set the artwork manually (cover, banner, hero, logo as applicable). The game itself is fully importable and launchable without artwork — this is purely cosmetic.

### Notes

- The base APK is unmodified XiaoJi GameHub 6.0.1; only the bytecode/resources required by the patches above are touched.
- **A fresh install is required if a previous release is still installed.** Each release run generates a new debug keystore, so the signing certificate differs between releases and Android refuses the upgrade with `INSTALL_FAILED_UPDATE_INCOMPATIBLE` (signature mismatch). Uninstall the previous version of the same variant first, then install the new one. Within a single release, all 9 variants are signed with the same cert.
- The `.rvp` patch bundle and `.rve` extension files are also attached for use with `revanced-cli` directly.

Twelve fixes since v0.24.0, most of them about surviving the next TikTok build.

**Fixed**
- Turning clear display on no longer looks to TikTok like you asked for it. Two of the three events the patch stops had not matched anything in this version for some time, and were looked up in a way that gave no sign they were missing, so the patch reported success and sent them anyway.
- A video reached through TikTok's translated video path now gets the same download treatment as any other. The hook was installed on one of the two ways out of that method.
- A Feature Gate Lab change that fails halfway no longer erases the record of which gates had actually fired.
- An override profile written somewhere other than the Lab now applies on a Turkish phone.
- A gate override whose type the catalogue disagrees with is refused rather than handed to TikTok, where it crashed in the app's own code.

**Faster**
- Comment translation stops doing reflection and taking a lock for batches it never asked for, which it did on TikTok's own thread for every batch in the app.
- A gate override that replaces a whole configuration object is worked out once rather than parsed from scratch on every read.

**Sturdier**
- Forty injected calls named registers or instruction positions that were right on 46.2.3 and said nothing about any other version. They read them off the instructions they belong to now.
- Fourteen checks that failed with no message say what they were looking for, and a patch that cannot find its anchor fails the build rather than reporting that it applied.

**Validation**: 716 runtime tests pass, both lint gates are clean, the bundle carries 70 patches and passes checks for all three DEX payloads, all 70 apply to the vendor 46.2.3 APK, and two builds of this commit produce the same file byte for byte.

Needs Morphe Manager 1.29.0 or newer. Patch on the device with Morphe Manager and keep its existing signing key.

## Features

### English Globe Key Ignore Delay

- Added a new "English Globe Key Ignore Delay" setting
- Lets you override the delay during which the globe key cannot switch languages immediately after typing letters on the English keyboard
- The stock default value is `500ms`
- The configurable range is now `0-1000ms`

If you want to switch languages faster after typing on the English keyboard, you can now reduce the delay. If you want to remove the wait entirely, you can set it directly to `0ms`.

## Improvements

### Settings Page Refactor

- Redesigned the overall structure of the Patches settings page to make feature grouping clearer
- Improved multilingual copy and settings page details for a more complete overall experience

- 可覆寫英文鍵盤在輸入字母後，地球鍵暫時不能立刻切換語言的延遲時間
- 原始預設值為 `500ms`
- 現在可自訂範圍為 `0-1000ms`

如果你希望英文輸入後可以更快切換語言，現在可以把延遲調低；如果想完全取消這段等待，也可以直接設成 `0ms`。

- 改善多語系文案與設定頁細節，讓整體使用體驗更完整

Загрузчики открывать не нужно — они работают внутри ReVanced Manager.
2. ReVanced Manager → **Патчи** → ✏️ → **Добавить патчи** → **Введите URL** → `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Allvoid/arsound/main/patches.json` → **Добавить**.
3. **Приложения** → **com.soundcloud.android** → **Патч** → на APKMirror: **2026.09.02-release**, **arm64-v8a**, **Download APK bundle** → **Установить**.

Ниже — подробная инструкция с пояснениями к каждому шагу.

---

# Установка по шагам

Понадобятся: телефон на Android 8.0 или новее, интернет (лучше Wi-Fi — скачается около 100 МБ) и аккаунт SoundCloud.

Ниже названия кнопок написаны **жирным** — ровно так, как они подписаны на экране. Если ReVanced Manager у вас на английском, в скобках указано английское название.

## Шаг 1. Скачайте и установите ReVanced Manager

ReVanced Manager — официальное приложение проекта ReVanced. Оно встраивает Arsound в SoundCloud.

1. Откройте на телефоне ссылку: **[revanced-manager-2.6.0.apk](https://github.com/ReVanced/revanced-manager/releases/download/v2.6.0/revanced-manager-2.6.0.apk)**. Начнётся скачивание файла.
2. Когда файл скачается, нажмите на уведомление о загрузке (или откройте «Файлы» → «Загрузки» и нажмите на `revanced-manager-2.6.0.apk`).
3. Если Android напишет, что установка из этого источника запрещена, нажмите **Настройки**, включите переключатель **Разрешить из этого источника** и вернитесь назад кнопкой «Назад».
4. Нажмите **Установить**.
5. Если появится окно Google Play Защиты о неизвестном приложении — нажмите **Подробнее** → **Всё равно установить**.
6. Дождитесь надписи «Приложение установлено» и нажмите **Готово**.

## Шаг 2. Скачайте и установите загрузчики для Manager

Это дополнение к Manager: благодаря ему Manager сам скачает SoundCloud нужной версии.

1. Откройте ссылку: **[revanced-manager-downloaders-1.2.0.apk](https://github.com/ReVanced/revanced-manager-downloaders/releases/download/v1.2.0/revanced-manager-downloaders-1.2.0.apk)**.
2. Установите файл так же, как в шаге 1: нажмите на скачанный файл → **Установить** → **Готово**.

Открывать это дополнение не нужно — у него нет своего экрана, оно работает внутри Manager.

## Шаг 3. Добавьте Arsound в Manager

1. Нажмите и удерживайте эту ссылку, затем выберите **Копировать ссылку** (или выделите текст и скопируйте):
   ```
   https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Allvoid/arsound/main/patches.json
   ```
2. Откройте приложение **ReVanced Manager**.
3. Вверху нажмите вкладку **Патчи** (Patches).
4. В правом нижнем углу нажмите круглую кнопку с **карандашом ✏️**.
5. Внизу появится кнопка **+ Добавить патчи** — нажмите её.
6. В окне «Добавить патчи» оставьте выбранным **Введите URL** (Enter URL) и нажмите **Далее**.
7. Нажмите на поле **URL патчей**, удерживайте палец и выберите **Вставить** — в поле появится скопированная ссылка.
8. Галочку **Автообновление** оставьте включённой — тогда новые версии Arsound будут приходить сами.
9. Нажмите **Добавить**.

Проверка: на вкладке «Патчи» появилась строка **Arsound v0.3.0 • 8 патчей**. Строка «ReVanced Patches» — это официальные патчи ReVanced, её трогать не нужно.

## Шаг 4. Пропатчите SoundCloud

1. Вверху нажмите вкладку **Приложения** (Apps).
2. Нажмите на строку поиска **Поиск приложений…** и напишите `SoundCloud`.
3. Нажмите на **com.soundcloud.android**. Под названием должна быть версия **2026.09.02-release**.
   Если там другая версия — смотрите «Частые вопросы» ниже.
4. Откроется экран «Информация о приложении». Ничего менять не нужно: все патчи Arsound уже выбраны. Нажмите синюю кнопку **Патч** (Patch) в правом нижнем углу.
5. Появится окно «APKMirror — Для продолжения работы этого загрузчика требуется взаимодействие с пользователем». Нажмите **Продолжить**.
6. Внутри Manager откроется сайт APKMirror (он на английском). Дальше:
   1. Немного пролистайте вниз до «Results for …» и нажмите на **SoundCloud: The Music You Love 2026.09.02-release**.
   2. На открывшейся странице нажмите оранжевую кнопку **SCROLL TO AVAILABLE DOWNLOADS**.
   3. Появится таблица вариантов. Нажмите на оранжевую надпись **2026.09.02-release** в строке, где в колонке «Arch» написано **arm64-v8a** (обычно это первая строка). Это вариант для почти всех современных телефонов.
   4. На странице варианта пролистайте немного вниз до оранжевой кнопки **DOWNLOAD APK BUNDLE** и нажмите её.
   Реклама на сайте — это реклама APKMirror, её можно просто пролистывать.
7. Manager сам вернётся к экрану «Патчер» и начнёт работу. Вы увидите три этапа: **Подготовка**, **Патчинг**, **Сохранение** — возле каждого по очереди появятся зелёные галочки. Это занимает 2–5 минут. Не сворачивайте Manager и не блокируйте телефон.
8. Когда все три этапа станут зелёными, внизу справа появится кнопка **Установить** (Install). Нажмите её.
9. Android спросит, установить ли приложение, — нажмите **Установить**. Если появится предупреждение Google Play Защиты — **Подробнее** → **Всё равно установить**.

## Шаг 5. Откройте Arsound

1. На рабочем столе или в списке приложений появится **Arsound** со своей иконкой.
2. Откройте его и войдите в свой аккаунт SoundCloud.
3. Настройки мода: значок профиля или **Library** → шестерёнка ⚙️ → пункт **Arsound**.

Оригинальный SoundCloud удалять не нужно — Arsound ставится отдельным приложением рядом с ним.

---

# Как обновить Arsound

Когда выйдет новая версия, Manager подтянет её сам (если в шаге 3 была включена галочка «Автообновление»). Чтобы обновить приложение: откройте ReVanced Manager → **Приложения** → **com.soundcloud.android** → **Патч** и повторите шаг 4. Arsound обновится поверх, настройки и вход сохранятся.

---

# Частые вопросы

**Под com.soundcloud.android в Manager написана не 2026.09.02-release, а другая версия.**
Нажмите на com.soundcloud.android → **Выберите патчи** → в правом нижнем углу круглая кнопка со **стрелкой и часами** (сброс) → внизу появится надпись «Выбор патчей и параметры были сброшены до рекомендуемых значений» → нажмите **Сохранить**. Вернитесь назад — версия станет 2026.09.02-release.

**Строка Arsound на вкладке «Патчи» красная или пишет, что патчи не могут быть загружены.**
Проверьте интернет и что ссылка вставлена полностью. Удалите строку (✏️ → значок корзины → **Подтвердить**) и добавьте заново по шагу 3.

**Сайт APKMirror не открывается или показывает проверку «Verify you are human».**
Отметьте проверку на сайте сами, как в обычном браузере, и продолжайте с пункта 6.1.

**При установке пишет «Приложение не установлено».**
На телефоне уже есть Arsound, установленный другим способом. Удалите его (удерживайте иконку Arsound → **Удалить**) и нажмите **Установить** в Manager ещё раз.

**Android спрашивает «Открыть с помощью: SoundCloud / Arsound».**
Выберите **Arsound**.

**Трек пишет «Недоступно в вашей стране», хотя в обычном SoundCloud играет.**
В Arsound: шестерёнка ⚙️ → **Arsound** → **Сбросить данные SoundCloud**. Вход в аккаунт и настройки Arsound сохранятся.

---

# Что умеет Arsound

Всё включается и выключается в приложении: шестерёнка ⚙️ → **Arsound**.

- **Без лишнего** — нет предложений подписки Go и Go+, телеметрия выключена, вкладку Upgrade можно скрыть.
- **Скачивание** — «Скачать файл» в меню трека, проверка скачивания плейлиста без дублей, скачанное играет без интернета, лишнее удаляется из меню.
- **Поиск Arsound** — во вкладке «Поиск» переключатель «SoundCloud / Arsound»: треки, которые в SoundCloud не скачать, ищутся в YouTube Music, слушаются одним нажатием и скачиваются в «Импортированные».
- **Своя музыка** — импорт аудиофайлов с телефона, плейлист «Импортированные», любые треки в любых плейлистах, свой порядок плейлистов перетаскиванием.
- **Мгновенные плейлисты** — плейлисты и альбомы открываются сразу, даже без интернета.
- **Сеть и батарея** — свой DNS, запрет выхода в сеть с российского IP, плашка статуса сети, вопрос перед проверкой устройства, экономия батареи.
- **Плеер** — эквалайзер, статистика прослушиваний, размер и срок хранения кэша.
- **Без дубликатов** — перезаливы одного трека скрываются в рекомендациях и на главной.

# Что нового в 0.6.0

- **Эквалайзер.** Настройки Arsound → **Эквалайзер**: пресеты телефона (Rock, Pop, Jazz и другие) или своя настройка ползунками по полосам. Звук меняется сразу, без перезапуска.
- **Статистика прослушиваний.** Настройки Arsound → **Статистика прослушиваний**: сколько времени вы слушали, самые частые треки и исполнители за 7 дней, 30 дней, год или всё время. Хранится только на телефоне, сбор можно выключить.
- **«Не нравится — не рекомендовать»** в меню «⋮» трека: трек пропадает с главной, из автовоспроизведения и из подборок SoundCloud (Your Mix, Daily Drops). Вернуть можно в настройках рекомендаций.
- **Дубликаты скрываются и в подборках SoundCloud** — Your Mix, Daily Drops, Weekly Wave. Версии с другой скоростью («0.9 speed», «1.2x», slowed) по желанию считаются тем же треком.
- **Папка-наблюдатель.** Настройки Arsound → Своя музыка → **Следить за папкой**: новые аудиофайлы из выбранной папки на телефоне импортируются сами.
- **Кэш потоков.** Настройки Arsound → Офлайн и воспроизведение: размер кэша от 250 МБ до 20 ГБ, срок хранения и очистка.

Всё новое включается и выключается в настройках Arsound.
